sentences.en: A committee of experts determines how to allocate the money.
sentences.zh: 一个专家小组决定如何分配这笔钱。

sentences.en: They refuse to allocate enough funds to buy new ventilators.
sentences.zh: 他们拒绝拨出足够的资金购买新的呼吸机。

sentences.en: In Algeria, the best lands were allocated to European settlers.
sentences.zh: 在阿尔及利亚，最好的土地被分给了欧洲移民者。

mnemonic: 词根记忆：al（加强）+loc（地方）+ate（做）→不断往地方送→分配
